hotsync_activity.reason: VIIRS active-cell totals calibrated to the MODIS+VIIRS union on overlap days
hotsync_activity.grid_note: Uses PyroScope calendar_cells grid (PYRO_CELL_DEG; default 0.5 degrees), not HotSync's ~2 km grid
hotsync_activity.baseline: same day-of-year +/- window in all other years (leave-one-year-out)

caveat: An episode is a statistical candidate: a z-score does not prove that an event is scientifically exceptional (see `robustness` and anomaly_validation.json). 'low' flags can be satellite or ground-segment outages, not less fire; days that look like partial outages are excluded. A single reference sensor family is assumed; the trend is not removed.
